notes: 48 synthetic rules matching the updated FIT HANU campus IT symptom IDs (SYM01–SYM27) to cause IDs (CAUSE01–CAUSE14). Each rule: if every symptom in `if` is present, `then` is a possible cause. Several causes intentionally share overlapping symptom sets (e.g. R005 vs R007, R019 vs R024) so that ambiguous scenarios can yield multiple candidate causes — that overlap is the required-experiment and ambiguous-scenario material.
